clauses.E-GLOBALS: Globals: SET / KILL subtree / $GET / $DATA, restored by rollback
clauses.E-PARTIAL: Partial rollback (TROLLBACK 1), globals and SQL rows alike
clauses.E-PPG: Process-private globals: not rolled back, private
clauses.E-VIS: Visibility: no isolation for globals, READ UNCOMMITTED for SQL
clauses.E-ROLLBACK-OTHER: Rollback does not overwrite another process's later write
clauses.E-SQL-END: SQL COMMIT / ROLLBACK end one level
clauses.E-DRV: Driver commit() one level / rollback() every level
clauses.E-AUTOCOMMIT: Autocommit default on; off: first DML opens a level; turning it on commits one open level
clauses.E-LOCK-DEFER: Locks: deferred release inside a transaction
clauses.E-CALLER: SQL and Native API of one connection share a server process
clauses.X-FX: Functional index entries in the row's statement and transaction
clauses.X-DDL: DDL: catalog effects, in a transaction rolled back with it
clauses.X-NULL: NULL and '' encodings on the two client paths; COALESCE guard
clauses.X-STMT: Statement-level atomicity; a failed statement still opens the autocommit-off transaction
clauses.X-STAR: SELECT * column order; ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN appends
clauses.X-TLEVEL-SQL: SELECT $TLEVEL; a query does not open a transaction
clauses.X-VEC: Vector SQL functions availability; $VECTOR in a global
clauses.X-ZSTRIP: $ZSTRIP classes C and W and actions * < > =
